data.title: Learn a concept from a bounded source pack
data.summary: Turn trusted material into an explanation, practice questions and a self-check.

sources.title: Learn a new concept: provider example

facts.text: OpenAI publishes a learning example that turns dense source material into a reviewable learning report. This is a provider example, not an independent learning-outcome study.

prerequisites: Access to ChatGPT Chat or Work; check account, client and workspace availability.
Course notes, documentation or public references you are allowed to use.
steps: State the learning goal and ask for a short diagnostic before the explanation.
Identify definitions and prerequisites in the supplied sources; mark gaps.
Explain one concept with an analogy, then show where the analogy fails.
Attempt a new problem yourself before requesting hints or the solution.
Check your explanation against the source and save a short error log for the next session.
data.output: a source-linked lesson, practice set and error log
validation: Identify the misconception and offer a smaller hint before revealing the solution.
Label the gap and request an appropriate reference.
limitations: Sintra-authored procedure based on provider documentation or demonstrations; no execution in the named app was performed.
Availability and results depend on your inputs, enabled tools and permissions; a suggested practice result is not a measured outcome.
data.prompt: Help me learn [concept] from [source pack] so I can [target task]. Start with three short diagnostic questions. Use source-linked definitions, explain prerequisites and give one analogy with its limits. Set a new practice problem and wait for my attempt before revealing the answer. Give targeted feedback, then ask me to explain the concept in my own words. Save an error log and flag anything the source pack does not establish.
tips: Ask for retrieval practice, not just a polished summary.
Keep source-backed definitions separate from illustrative analogies.

practice.task: Learn percentage change using values 100 and 120, then predict the reverse change.
practice.expected: Forward change is 20%; reverse is about −16.67%, with the different base explained.
